d:
In India, a helicopter crash in Uttarakhand killed all six people on board. The casualties include the pilot. The chopper was travelling from Badrinath to Dehradun, before it lost communication and crashed. The cause of the crash is not yet known. Hem Kaur Saroya explains on Vantage.
